text:
carla_customer: hitting 400 from /v1/invoke when streaming function calls. payload seems to cut off mid-JSON. example attached.

alice_support: sorry for the trouble — can you paste the exact root request and the SSE body you received?

carla_customer: here's the last SSE chunks i got (trimmed):
```
data: {"tool":"charge","args":{"order_id":12345,"amount":49


data: "\n"
```

carla_customer: you can see it ends after 49 and no closing braces. server returns 400 with "invalid_json".

ben_backend: thanks. do you have the request id/header (x-rw-request-id)?

carla_customer: x-rw-request-id: rw-req-2026-03-15-9t2m

maria_infra: any proxy in front? this looks like chunk boundary chopping the JSON mid-token. last deploy touched our nginx config yesterday.

sam_engineer: hmm we saw an nginx upgrade on 2026-03-15 that enabled http2 chunk coalescing. @maria_infra can you confirm keepalive/flush settings?

deploy-bot: deploy completed: nginx 1.24.0 -> 1.24.1 on lb-prod (2026-03-15T18:23:42Z)

maria_infra: confirmed, keepalive_timeout changed from 65 -> 30 in that deploy. also proxy_buffering off? looking.

alice_support: in the meantime, workaround for customer: set stream=disabled or use websocket transport? any quick safe suggestion?

ben_backend: we can add server-side reassembly on the SSE parser to buffer until a valid JSON parse succeeds for tool args; risky but possible as hotfix.

olivia_prod: can we reproduce internally? @carla_customer do you have a curl/wget trace we can run?

carla_customer: yes i'll DM the raw network capture. thanks all :pray:

sam_engineer: capturing steps for repro: 1) call v1/invoke with toolcall and streaming enabled 2) route via our LB with nginx 1.24.1 3) reproduce by sending multi-byte UTF-8 in strings and enable gzip on proxy 4) observe SSE event that splits in middle of multibyte char -> JSON invalid

maria_infra: noted. rolling back keepalive change to previous value temporarily, will monitor 15m.

alice_support: tagging for escalation to SRE if rollback doesn't fix in 15m. thanks everyone.
